text: [sighs] Look, I have to talk to you.
[sighs] I know you were very excited to go to the lake. [sympathetic] But we won't be able to go today. [sadly] I'm sorry.
[nervously] Because, well... [pause] the meteorological conditions... [nervous laugh] are not optimal right now.
[quickly] No. [dismissive] I'm not scared. [proudly] I'm just optimizing our long-term survivability.
